'''Kamino Station X''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="TFU2" /> After the [[Assault on Kamino]] in the [[1 BBY/Legends|year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Comic">The events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' happen in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]].</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] found the notes of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Lead Cloning Technician]] in a [[garbage processing facility]] at the station.<ref name="TFU2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kamino Station X was mentioned in the [[Dark Apprentice]] Databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="TFU2" />
